verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents `pulumi import`, which adds an existing cloud resource to the stack's state and generates the code needed to manage it. It also documents adoption/import as a migration workflow and an import-file mechanism via `pulumi preview --import-file` for handling multiple resources. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of import/codegen quality, deeper documentation of bulk import (generated code must be manually copied into the program).
